question: Who is the author of the book 'Ethical Religion'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ethical Religion was authored by M.K. Gandhi.**
 
• M. K. Gandhi was a **prolific writer.** He founded and edited** several newspapers/journals including Indian Opinion, Young India.**
 
• There are innumerable books that are collections of Gandhi's writings on various topics.
 
• Here are the three books that Gandhi wrote:
 
 
• **Hind Swaraj or Indian Home Rule (1909)**
 
• **India of My Dreams (1947).**
 
• **Nature Cure (1948) (**posthumously)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi indeed wrote a book titled "Key to Health," sometimes referred to as "Nature Cure," which was published posthumously in 1948,**.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi was born in Porbandar Town of the Bombay Presidency on 2 October 1869**, the year in which Lord Mayo took office as Governor-General of India.
 
• The** honorific Mahātmā first applied to him in 1914 in South Africa**, is now used throughout the world.
